handoff.entry_conditions: Observable entry may be early or late in lid release: lid_position is about 1.71 rad at index 740 with the fingers still closed on the lid, or the lid is already released/open with the fingers near 0.04 m. The peg must still be inside the box. Required motion is release/clearance if needed, open-gripper approach to peg_pose, close around the peg, and lift while maintaining peg-gripper coupling.
handoff.exit_conditions: Observable exit cue: fingers are closed near 0.012-0.013 m, the peg has risen from z about 0.026 m to roughly 0.44-0.48 m by index 1270, the TCP and peg move together, and the peg is clear of the box walls. Initial reorientation/transport may already be underway.
handoff.failure_signatures: The hand remains attached to the lid rather than targeting the peg; the lid blocks the approach; fingers close while TCP is offset from peg_pose; peg z stays near 0.026 m after the lift command; peg and TCP cease co-motion; or peg height/trajectory indicates wall contact. Demonstrations show successful pickup only and do not prove regrasp or drop recovery.
handoff.overlap_role: Incoming overlap with open_hinged_lid is [740,950), 210 actions/10.5 s per trajectory, teaching lid release and approach clearance before the peg becomes the active object. Outgoing overlap with reorient_and_stage_peg is [1120,1270), 150 actions/7.5 s per trajectory, teaching closed-grasp consolidation, lift, box clearance, and initial turn. Both are action-supervised overlaps.
handoff.successor_readiness: reorient_and_stage_peg is ready when the closed gripper is carrying the peg above the box rim and peg_pose co-moves with tcp_pose. Switching can occur during the shared lift; later switching is safer if peg z is high and lid motion has settled.

name: Release lid, grasp peg, and lift clear
segmentation_rationale: This responsibility changes the active object from the lid to the peg and contains the discrete open-to-close grasp event plus extraction from the box. The segment intentionally starts at 740 while the lid is still held, because observed actions release it around 760-770 before the open-gripper transit. In demo12200 the arm passes above/around the box at 900-990, descends toward the peg at 1020-1080, closes by 1100, and lifts through 1120-1240; the front image at 1030 shows the open gripper over the peg. At each 1270 boundary the peg is elevated and the gripper is closed. This breadth is expected to tolerate handoff timing, not unseen grasp failures.

subgoal: After exposing the box, release and clear the lid if necessary, approach the peg with open fingers, close a stable grasp, and lift the peg above the box walls.
